brief:
The United Arab Emirates declined to address questions about whether it had alerted Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to a potential Hamas attack before October 7, according to Middle East Eye. The National, an Abu Dhabi-based newspaper, posed the questions to the UAE, with a Haaretz report later documenting the emirate's response.

The incident raises questions about pre-attack intelligence sharing between Gulf states and Israel ahead of the operation that killed hundreds of Israelis and triggered the subsequent war in Gaza.
dek: UAE dodges question on pre-October 7 warning to Netanyahu The UAE addressed questions from The National, an Abu Dhabi-based newspaper, about whether it had alerted Netanyahu to a potential Hamas attack ahead of October 7, according to a Haaretz report.
title: UAE avoids answering if it warned Netanyahu of Hamas attack
